article_title: Amazon India Decodes The Changing World of Lab-Grown Diamonds & The Rise of Everyday Fine Jewellery | Femina.in
sub_title: Amazon India is debunking the myths surrounding lab-grown diamonds and winning over a new generation of informed jewellery lovers
article_content: Today's jewellery shopper is rewriting the rules of fine jewellery. Through insights from Amazon.in we understand that for Gen Z and Millennials, diamonds are no longer reserved for weddings or milestone celebrations, they're becoming part of everyday style, self-expression and self-gifting. This shift is particularly evident among women aged 24–38, who are increasingly choosing jewellery that reflects their personal style rather than waiting for a special occasion. Alongside engagements and milestone celebrations, self-gifting and even "no occasion" purchases are becoming key reasons to buy fine jewellery. This evolution is also reflected in the growing popularity of Lab-Grown Diamonds, which have moved from a niche curiosity to a mainstream jewellery choice in just a few years. Siddharth Bhagat, Director, Amazon Beauty, Personal Care and Fashion Accessories, says, "The Lab-grown Diamond category on Amazon.in has seen a remarkable 9X increase since the start of the year. While metros continue to drive strong demand, we're also seeing growing interest from Tier 2 & 3 cities. Customers are increasingly choosing lab-grown diamonds not just for gifting, but also for everyday wear. Today, customers can choose from leading Lab-grown Diamond brands on Amazon.in, including GIVA, Sparkles, Lukson and KEEMTI, offering products backed by trusted certifications such as IGI, GIA and SGL. As the category continues to evolve, we remain committed to expanding selection, strengthening trust through authenticity and enabling customers to continue shopping with greater confidence." Siddharth Bhagat – Director, Amazon Beauty, Personal Care and Fashion Accessories While awareness continues to grow, so do misconceptions. Here are four of the most common myths surrounding lab-grown diamonds and the facts behind them. Myth 1: Buying Diamonds Online Isn't Trustworthy The online jewellery shopping experience has evolved significantly over the years. Customers today expect detailed product imagery, comprehensive specifications, transparent pricing, trusted certifications and authentic customer reviews before making a purchase. Brand-backed buyback and exchange programmes are also emerging as important trust signals. Amazon Fashion supports this journey with a growing selection from leading lab-grown diamond brands, backed by strict seller verification and product certification guardrails, helping customers shop the  greater confidence. The category's growth reflects this increasing confidence. While Metro and Tier 1 cities currently account for 46% of transacting customers, demand is expanding rapidly across Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets, highlighting how awareness and adoption of Lab-Grown Diamonds are growing across India. Myth 2: A Lab-Grown Diamond Loses Shine, Durability, Or Value Over Time One of the most common misconceptions is that lab-grown diamonds are less durable or lose their brilliance over time. In reality, lab-grown diamonds have the same physical, chemical and optical properties as mined diamonds. They are equally durable, with the same hardness of 10 on the Mohs scale, and retain the same brilliance and sparkle over time. The difference lies only in how they are created —not in their quality or performance. Trusted certifications from recognised institutions such as IGI, GIA and SGL further validate their authenticity, giving customers confidence in every purchase. Like natural diamonds, many lab-grown diamond brands also offer buyback and exchange programmes, while warranties are determined by the brand's policies rather than whether the diamond is mined or lab-grown. This version directly debunks the stated myth while naturally incorporating the additional trust signals. A sustainable future with lab-grown diamonds While affordability is an important factor, it isn't the only reason customers are embracing lab-grown diamonds. Costing up to one-third the price of comparable mined diamonds, they offer the same physical, chemical and optical properties, with the only difference being how they are created, not what they are. This gives customers the flexibility to choose larger stones or more intricate designs within the same budget. Beyond value, shoppers are increasingly drawn to their contemporary designs and everyday versatility, with earrings and pendants, followed by rings, emerging as the most popular categories. A diverse range of jewellery Today's shoppers no longer wait for an occasion to buy fine jewellery. While engagements, anniversaries and festive gifting continue to drive demand, one of the fastest-growing trends is jewellery purchased for "no occasion at all." Minimalist studs, delicate pendants and everyday rings have become wardrobe essentials, particularly among working women, who are increasingly incorporating fine jewellery into their everyday style. Rising discretionary spending among women is further contributing to this shift, with jewellery becoming a reflection of personal expression rather than something reserved for milestone moments. Jewellery for every occasion and beyond Another common myth is that lab-grown diamonds can be identified with the naked eye. In reality, lab-grown and mined diamonds are visually identical, sharing the same cut, colour, clarity and carat characteristics. Even professional gemologists rely on specialised equipment and certification to determine a diamond's origin. This is why recognised certifications from organisations such as IGI, GIA and SGL play an important role in giving customers confidence and transparency when purchasing lab-grown diamond jewellery. Bringing Discovery to Life Amazon India's Lab-Grown Diamond Experience This evolving relationship with lab-grown diamonds came to life at The Carat Collective, Amazon India's Lab-Grown Diamond experience, held in Bengaluru on August 3. Bringing together creators, the immersive event was designed to spark discovery, build awareness and help demystify the category through curated collections, interactive zones and myth-busting experiences. Attendees explored contemporary collections from GIVA, Sparkles, Lukson and KEEMTI, while a panel discussion featuring Siddharth Bhagat, Director,  Amazon Beauty, Personal Care and Fashion Accessories; Aditya Labroo, Founder, GIVA; Anand Lukhi, CEO & Co-founder, Lukson; and Armaan Kothari, Founder, KEEMTI, unpacked conversations around trust, certification, pricing, design innovation and the future of lab-grown diamonds in India. The discussion also addressed common misconceptions, including whether lab-grown diamonds can be identified by sight, whether they lose their shine or durability over time, and how certification plays a critical role in helping customers shop with confidence. Designed as a discovery-led experience, The Carat Collective reinforced Amazon India's commitment to expanding selection, strengthening trust and empowering customers through education making the journey of discovering lab-grown diamonds more informed, approachable and inspiring. article_title: Meet The Faces Of ‘The One And Only’ By Blenders Pride | Femina.in
sub_title: ‘The One And Only’ campaign by Blenders Pride features Avanti Nagrath, Kirandeep Chahal, and Mahieka Sharma.
article_content: Nothing short of a cultural icon, Blenders Pride Packaged Drinking Water has defined aspirational success for generations. Scripting a new definition of what it means to be successful in today’s world, the brand has recently unveiled its bold new campaign titled ‘The One And Only’. The narrative simply reasserts a timeless truth, that true success lies in distinction, putting you in a league of your own. The campaign portrays three remarkable protagonists, each embodying a different facet of the brand. Capturing the essence perfectly are Avanti Nagrath, Kirandeep Chahal, and Mahieka Sharma. While Avanti radiates charisma with her fearless confidence and individuality, Kirandeep evokes desire with her magnetic and unapologetic presence, and Mahieka inspires awe with poise and quiet admiration. In a world filled with many equals, they not only command attention but stand apart with an unmistakable aura, much like the brand itself. Mahieka Sharma A fashion model and lifestyle creator, Mahieka has steadily built a name for herself through runway fashion, editorial campaigns, and wellness-led content. She has a background in economics and finance, initially having balanced academics with modelling before fully stepping into the fashion industry. Over the years, she has walked for some of India’s most celebrated designers including Manish Malhotra, Tarun Tahiliani, Amit Aggarwal, and Anita Dongre. Mahieka’s work spans fashion weeks, music videos, digital campaigns, and commercial shoots for brands like Vivo and Uniqlo. Known for her calm confidence and minimal, wellness-driven aesthetic, Mahieka’s social presence combines fashion, yoga , travel, and fitness. She was also recognised with the “Model of the Year” title at the Indian Fashion Awards, further cementing her place among India’s emerging fashion faces. Image: Instagram Avanti Nagrath One of India’s most promising international fashion models, Avanti made a strong mark on global runways at a young age. Born and raised in Delhi, she began modelling as a teenager while balancing school and competitive basketball, eventually turning her passion into a full-time career. Her breakthrough came in 2022 when she opened the Versace Fall/Winter show at Milan Fashion Week, becoming one of the few Indian models to achieve such a milestone. Since then, Avanti has walked for some of the world’s most prestigious luxury houses, including Versace, Dior, Burberry, Hermès, Bottega Veneta, Coperni, Jacquemus, Givenchy, and Chanel. She has also been a regular presence at major Indian fashion weeks, collaborating with celebrated designers such as Tarun Tahiliani, Manish Malhotra, and Rahul Mishra. Recognised for her striking runway presence and effortless versatility, Avanti represents a new generation of Indian talent redefining global fashion. Besides her rapid rise, she is known for her grounded personality, love for sports, and commitment to continuous learning and creative exploration. Image: Instagram Kirandeep Chahal This fashion model has steadily built a name for herself through both Indian and international runway work. Originally from Punjab, Kirandeep began her journey studying journalism before eventually moving into modelling full-time. Over the years, she has become known for her striking runway presence, sharp features, and ability to balance high-fashion editorials with commercial campaigns. She has worked with leading Indian designers including Manish Malhotra, Tarun Tahiliani, and Gaurav Gupta, while also making a mark internationally. One of the biggest milestones in her career came when she walked for Dior at Paris Fashion Week, becoming one of the few Indian models to represent India on that global stage. She has also walked for Dries Van Noten and has been part of major showcases at Lakmé Fashion Week and FDCI. Kirandeep’s journey reflects persistence, individuality, and a strong sense of identity, making her one of the emerging Indian models gaining recognition on the global fashion circuit. Image: Instagram Rolled out as a comprehensive 360-degree initiative, ‘The One And Only’ campaign was showcased across digital channels, including the ICC T20 World Cup, alongside high-impact front-page placements in leading newspapers and prominent outdoor hoardings across key metros. Presenting the three women as figures who naturally attract respect and wield influence within a world built on aspiration, it highlights that even in a landscape full of accomplished peers, these individuals have a matchless aura. article_content: There are small decisions that can change the outcome of a match. And of a recipe too. Olympic champion Carolina Marín knows this better than anyone. After years of competing and dominating badminton at the highest level, she has learned that it is often the smallest details that make the biggest difference. From winning world titles to becoming one of the most recognised athletes in the world, her journey has been shaped by discipline, instinct and the ability to make the right decision at the right moment. And that same approach to performance goes far beyond the badminton court. "People think performance depends on the big moments. But for me, it has always been about the small details. Those little adjustments that change everything," she explains. It is a philosophy that naturally resonates with today's lifestyle, especially in India, where balancing work, home and wellbeing is part of everyday life. The Detail That Makes All the Difference When we ask Carolina about the move she uses to surprise her opponents, she doesn't hesitate: "Sometimes it's rushing to the net, sometimes it's a backhand, or changing direction unexpectedly. The idea is always the same: to create that element of surprise." And she brings that very same mindset into the kitchen. There is something quietly powerful about the small choices we make every day. The ingredients we choose, the way we present a dish, the care we put into the moments we share at home. Because small changes can make a big difference. Try snacking something new. Across India, more and more food lovers are embracing a new way of cooking and hosting at home, one that blends tradition with global inspiration. A familiar dal, a comforting pulao or a simple snack can become something more. Something truly memorable. Three Varieties, Endless Possibilities Just like in sport, making the right choice makes all the difference. " You don't need to change your recipes, just add a small twist," explains the Olympic champion. And in Indian cuisine, that simple change works surprisingly well: An easy way to explore new flavours without losing the essence of traditional Indian cooking. A Natural Fit for Today's Lifestyle As ambassador of the ‘Feed Your Heart with Olives from Spain’ campaign, Carolina represents a lifestyle built around balance and conscious choices. Olives are rich in healthy fats, especially oleic acid, as well as vitamin E, minerals and fibre, making them a delicious and balanced choice for everyday meals. With more than 3,000 years of history, Spain has become the world's leading producer and exporter of table olives. Olives from Spain are deeply rooted in Mediterranean culture, renowned for its commitment to high-quality ingredients and one of the healthiest eating patterns in the world: the Mediterranean diet. Today, that way of life connects naturally with Indian kitchens, where sharing food and enjoying time around the table also play an important role in everyday family life.
